children: CHARLOTTE, N.C., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oakworth Capital Bank (OTCQX: OAKC) is pleased to announce that
, attorney and managing member of
, and Andrew Giraldo, president and chief financial officer of
, have joined its Charlotte Market Board.

Lord is a trial attorney with extensive experience in fiduciary and commercial litigation, representing clients in complex disputes involving closely held businesses, trusts and estates and shareholder matters. He has tried cases before judges and juries across North Carolina and is recognized for his work in commercial litigation by Chambers USA, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers in America and Legal 500.

"I've worked with both national and community banks throughout my career, but the difference with a local bank is the relationship," said Lord. "You're working with people who know you, understand your business and are focused on finding solutions that actually fit your needs. It's the people, it's the culture, it's what Charlotte needs and it's what Oakworth brings."

Giraldo brings extensive experience in corporate finance, business growth and renewable energy development, including his work at NARENCO, a renewable energy company that develops and operates large-scale solar energy projects across the eastern United States.

"Having worked with banks of all sizes throughout my career, what sets Oakworth apart is the level of service," said Giraldo. "The team is responsive, relationship-focused and committed to finding solutions that meet clients' needs. Oakworth's values align with those I believe are essential to building a successful business, and I'm excited to support the bank's continued growth in the Charlotte market."

"We are pleased to welcome both Harrison and Andrew to the Charlotte Market Board," said Tim Beck, managing director and Charlotte market leader for Oakworth Capital Bank. "Their experience and perspective will be valuable as we continue to grow in this market."
Lord earned his juris doctor with honors from Washington University in St. Louis and holds a Bachelor of Arts from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
Giraldo holds a Bachelor of Arts in economics from Transylvania University and a master's degree in finance from the University of Michigan.
About Oakworth Capital Bank

Oakworth Capital Bank (OTCQX: OAKC) was founded in 2008 and operates four offices in the Southeast, including its headquarters in Birmingham, Alabama. Oakworth provides commercial and private banking, wealth management, and advisory services to clients across the United States.

Oakworth has been ranked among American Banker's "Best Banks to Work For in the U.S." for the past nine years, holding the top spot for six of those years and ranking No. 2 most recently. Additionally, Oakworth's 2025 average Net Promoter Score (NPS) was 95 with a commensurate client retention rate of 95%. As of June 30, 2026, Oakworth had $2.1 billion in total assets, $1.7 billion in gross loans, $1.8 billion in deposits and $3.0 billion in wealth and trust assets under management. For more information, visit www.oakworth.com.
